_meta.name: discovery-stage risk-flag ground truth (KDD §7.5 item 2)
_meta.author: agent-curated (Pranay's session, 2026-09-12)
_meta.rubric: Note-level business reality, NOT packet-level: a flag is expected when a competent travel advisor reading the raw note would raise it at discovery stage. This grades the FULL pipeline (extraction + decision) — extraction misses are counted as pipeline failures, which is the real-world measure. Severity: visa_timeline_risk is 'medium' when nothing is booked with ample lead time, 'high' when the note implies a tight window. Only flags observable at discovery stage are labeled (margin_risk is booking-stage; labeled N/A everywhere).
caveats: Author-curated labels — the same agent designed the experiment and the rubric. Bias mitigations: rubric fixed BEFORE grading (this file was written before any graded run was scored); binary per flag+severity; rubric grounded in the corpus fixtures' own documented intent.

Visa judgment assumes Indian-passport travelers (agency corpus default): Schengen (Iceland/Greece/Portugal/Italy/Europe), Japan, Vietnam, Kenya, Costa Rica require advance visas; Bali/Thailand/Maldives/Singapore require visa-on-arrival or eVisa — all still flagged for lead-time planning.
budget_hard_001 'the coast' is treated as domestic-unknown (no visa flag); if the business intends coastal-international, flip this record and re-grade.
toddler_pacing_risk labeled for notes mentioning young children without age certainty (neg_002, neg_005) at medium.

excluded_flags.traveler_safe_leakage_risk: Pipeline-integrity flag (internal-data boundary), not a travel-risk judgment. Emitted deterministically on records with blocking ambiguities; excluded from risk-flag precision/recall grading (2026-09-12, after first grading pass surfaced the vocabulary gap).

budget_simple_002.note: 'trip to Europe' — international; tests full-pipeline grading even though city-level extraction misses 'Europe'

budget_neg_008.note: Singapore; also exposes the dest='Of' extraction artifact

colloq_dates_season_001.note: cherry-blossom window = seasonal constraint, still medium
